```{r load-lib, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```



```{r}
bike_data <- read.csv("SeoulBikeData.csv")
```


```{r}
bike_data %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  mutate(max_bikes = max(Rented.Bike.Count), na.rm=TRUE)
print(bike_data)
```
```{r}
max_hours <- bike_data %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  filter( 6<=Hour & Hour<=11) %>%
  filter(Rented.Bike.Count == max(Rented.Bike.Count))

library(infer)
boot_hours <- max_hours %>%
  specify(response=Hour) %>%
  generate(reps=5000, type ="bootstrap") %>%
  calculate(stat="mean")

ggplot(data = boot_hours, mapping = aes(x = stat)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025) +
  labs(title = "Bootstrap distribution of means")

boot_hours %>%
  summarize(lower = quantile(stat, 0.025),
            upper = quantile(stat, 0.975))

  
#we are 95% confident that the mean time to travel to work is between 8.73 hours and 9.02 hours  

```
